name: Meddle
description:
Trigger: a creature within medium range would make a skill check or damage roll.

If the trigger is a skill check, it becomes favored or ill-favored (your choice).

If the trigger is a damage roll, upgrade or downgrade each die in the roll by one die type. The creature still adds any modifiers to the total.

Either way, check a Condition. In the Condition was Insecure, the creature takes -1d to the roll.

Describe how you intervene.
